w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Spool is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Agnese walks you through Chorus Line. (Monster codex: observed.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Callback is here.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 💥 The attack finds you — no dodging it.
The attack hits you for 10.

You STRIKE the stripes flowing where no wind blows for 10.

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: Rubble chokes the path.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Emilio freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
You turn to leave — behind you, The Timeslot stirs.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/13/6), with 6 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 22 · Craft 12 · Talk 15 · Explore 47 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Carlos returns from the wilds hurt (health 7/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Carlos returns from the wilds hurt (health 7/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Agnese returns from the wilds hurt (health 4/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Chris returns from the wilds hurt (health 3/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: ✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
